text:
Maya: Hey folks — uploaded a quick prototype for the first-run minibanner (inline strip at top) + optional one-click checklist. link: https://figma.com/proto/mini-onboard. Looking for microcopy, keyboard focus behavior, and any a11y nits. Ryan: Nice! Quick thought on copy: 'Get started' feels vague. Maybe 'Create your first project' or 'Run sample project' so the CTA maps to the action. Samir: Agree on CTA. Also worried about focus — if the minibanner appears, does keyboard focus move into it? We shouldn't trap the user. Prefer focus goes to the first interactive element in the banner and then Tab continues to page content. Leo: For screen reader flow, we should announce the banner via aria-live="polite" rather than moving focus automatically. Users who rely on keyboard shouldn't get surprised. Maya: Good points. Current prototype sets focus to the CTA to make it discoverable. Maybe that was too aggressive. Ryan: If we keep focus, add an obvious dismiss with accessible label ("Dismiss onboarding banner") and ensure Esc closes it. Samir: Also check tab order: the close button should be before CTAs in DOM so keyboard users can exit quickly. Leo: Small code sketch for the banner wrapper we can copy into components:```html

Kick off with a sample project to see Redwood in action.

``` Casey: Microcopy suggestions: - Headline: "Try a sample project" (short) - Body: "Deploy a demo app in seconds — no config required." - Primary CTA: "Run demo" - Secondary: "Browse templates" Would be nice to A/B 'Run demo' vs 'Create project' later. Maya: Love those. Contrast is another piece — dark text on semi-transparent banner might fail for some themes. onboarding-bot: Contrast check: banner background #ffffffcc on text #1a1a1a => WCAG AA fails for small text (ratio 3.4:1). Recommend reduce transparency or increase text weight. Leo: Thanks bot. Let's target 4.5:1 for body text or increase to large text size for AA. Ryan: UX question — should the minibanner persist across routes until dismissed? I lean yes for first session, but we should only show it once per account. Samir: Agree. Persist but with a short TTL (e.g., hide after first dismissal or after 24h). Logging impression + CTA click for analytics. Maya: Action items: 1) Update copy per Casey, 2) adjust focus behavior to aria-live and make close button keyboard-first (Samir), 3) fix contrast (Leo), 4) add impression/click events (Ryan). I'll push an updated figma and a small HTML prototype. Casey: Quick follow-up — can design make the close 44px touch target and add visible focus ring? Maya: Yep. I'll update. Thanks all — ping me any other nits and I'll incorporate for the next dev handoff. :thumbsup:
